guide.pane.title: Cell Guide
guide.banner.noSelection: Click any cell in a SKSB table to see what it means and what to enter.
guide.banner.outside: This cell is outside any data table. Click a cell inside a table to see its guide.
guide.banner.header: You selected a column header. Click any cell below it to see what to enter.
guide.banner.total: This is the Total row. Its values are calculated automatically and are not saved.
guide.banner.multi: {0} cells selected — showing the guide for the first cell ({1}).
guide.nature.absolute.name: Master list
guide.nature.absolute.desc: Master list: each row is one record (for example one staff member or one vehicle). Edit rows in place; saving makes the system match this list.
guide.nature.additive.name: History log
guide.nature.additive.desc: History log: each row is one dated entry. Add a new row for each new event; past entries are kept as history.
guide.nature.history.desc: Past entries are protected: if you edit an old row, SKSB will ask whether to undo the change or save it as a new entry.
guide.tip.header.sort: Use the arrow button on this header to sort or filter the column.
guide.tip.required: This field must be filled in before you can save to the system.
guide.tip.warningOnly: You may leave this blank, but you will get a reminder when saving.
guide.tip.dropdown: Pick a value using the dropdown arrow beside the cell, or start typing to search.
guide.tip.multiselect: You can pick several values; they are kept together in one cell, separated by commas.
guide.tip.calculated: This value is calculated automatically by SKSB and cannot be typed over.
guide.tip.readonly: This value is managed by SKSB. You can read it but not change it.
guide.tip.syncSource: Changing this value also fills in: {0}.
guide.tip.syncTarget: Filled in automatically from: {0}. You usually do not need to type it.
guide.tip.excelFormula: This cell contains an Excel formula.
guide.default.literal: If left blank, it is filled with "{0}".
guide.default.today: If left blank, it is filled with today's date.
guide.default.dateOffset: If left blank, a date is calculated automatically.
guide.default.autoIncrement: If left blank, the next running number is assigned automatically.
guide.default.generic: If left blank, a default value is filled in automatically.
guide.format.wage: RM per month (monthly) or per day (daily)
guide.quick.sort.title: Sort & Filter
guide.quick.sort.body: Click the arrow on any column header to sort A–Z or show only the rows you need. Choose 'Clear Filter' to see everything again.
guide.quick.insert.title: Insert Row
guide.quick.insert.body: Click 'Insert Row' on the ribbon to add a new row to the current table. Turn on 'Insert at Top' to add it at the top instead of the bottom.
guide.quick.save.title: Save to System
guide.quick.save.body: Click 'Save' when you are done. SKSB checks your data first and lists any problems in the Validation panel at the bottom of Excel.
guide.quick.offline.title: Offline Mode
guide.quick.offline.body: If the server cannot be reached, your work is kept safely on this PC. Click 'Ping Server' to go back online and upload it.
guide.spotlight.ctx.offline: You are in Offline Mode. Your work is saved on this PC — click 'Ping Server' on the ribbon when back online to sync.
guide.spotlight.ctx.multiselect: This field allows multiple choices — click the floating arrow next to the cell to tick more than one option.
guide.spotlight.ctx.autosync: This column fills in automatically from linked columns, so you usually do not need to type it.
guide.spotlight.ctx.history: This is a history log — add a new row for each new event instead of overwriting past entries.
guide.spotlight.ctx.dynamic_cost: Click the floating dropdown arrow beside this cell to choose which costs tally into Actual Project Cost across the sheet (view-only; Profit / Margin updates live, while saved records keep the full cost).
guide.spotlight.gen.ctrl_s: Press Ctrl+S anytime to validate your sheet and save directly to the system.
guide.spotlight.gen.insert_top: Toggle 'Insert at Top' on the ribbon if you prefer new rows added at the top of the table.
guide.spotlight.gen.trim_empty: Use 'Clean Empty Rows' on the ribbon to remove stray blank rows before saving.
guide.spotlight.gen.dedupe: Use 'Clean Duplicates' on the ribbon to find and remove accidental duplicate rows.
guide.spotlight.gen.total_row: Toggle 'Total Row' on the ribbon to view live sums for cost and amount columns.
guide.spotlight.gen.dropdown: Click the floating dropdown arrow beside a cell to pick valid entries without typing.
guide.spotlight.gen.language: You can switch the app language anytime using the Language dropdown on the Manager ribbon tab.
guide.spotlight.gen.dock_pane: Drag this Cell Guide by its title bar to dock it to the left or right edge of Excel.
guide.spotlight.gen.dictionary: Spot awkward wording or a better translation? Open 'Dictionary' in Portal to suggest improvements (including Manglish) or vote on teammates' suggestions — it is managed collectively by the team.
guide.spotlight.gen.template_portal: Want your own column widths, colours, or sheet layout? Turn on 'Edit Template Mode' in Portal to customise your personal workbook template (local to your PC, and you can reset it anytime).
guide.spotlight.gen.validate: Click 'Check Issues' on the ribbon anytime to scan your sheet for missing or invalid entries before saving.
guide.spotlight.gen.report_bug: Something look wrong or behaving strangely? Click 'Report Bug' on the ribbon — it automatically attaches a screenshot and log so it can be fixed fast.
guide.spotlight.gen.header_sort: Click the small arrow on any column header to sort A–Z or filter down to just the rows you need.
guide.spotlight.gen.reload_data: Click 'Load' on the ribbon anytime to pull the latest records from the server if a teammate made updates.
guide.spotlight.gen.total_row_filter: When you filter a table, the Total Row automatically totals only the visible rows — click any Total Row cell to switch between Sum, Count, or Average.
guide.spotlight.gen.insert_row: Use 'Insert Row' on the ribbon to add new entries so formulas, dropdowns, and formatting copy cleanly into the new row.
guide.spotlight.gen.delete_row: To remove a record cleanly, click any cell in that row and use 'Delete Row' on the ribbon.
guide.spotlight.gen.offline_safe: Lost server connection? Keep working — SKSB keeps a safe local draft on this PC and lets you sync when the server is back.
guide.spotlight.gen.cell_guide_toggle: Need more screen space? Click 'Cell Guide' on the ribbon (or its X button) to hide this pane — SKSB remembers your choice next session.
guide.spotlight.gen.date_filter: On sheets with top-bar date or range selectors, change those cells to quickly filter records to the period you need.
guide.spotlight.gen.auto_defaults: You can leave auto-default or running-number cells blank when adding a row — SKSB fills them in and formats them automatically.
guide.spotlight.gen.multi_select: On multi-select columns, click the floating dropdown arrow to tick multiple items at once instead of typing commas by hand.
guide.spotlight.gen.dynamic_cost: In Project Manager, click any 'Actual Project Cost' cell and open its floating dropdown arrow to choose which costs (Fuel, Labour, Claim) tally into the total — view-only, so saved records always keep the full cost.
